effect_description_eng:
When this card is trashed from your deck, if it wasn't trashed by [EX2-039 Impmon]'s effect, you may trash up to 3 cards from the top of your deck.
[On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with [Beelzemon] in its name and 1 [Ai & Mako] among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] If this Digimon has [Beelzemon] in its name, it gets +3000 DP.
